summary: Stepan Company filed an 8-K reporting Q1 2026 financial results, including a $65.4 million pre-tax restructuring charge tied to the previously announced closure of its Fieldsboro, NJ site and select assets at its Elwood (Millsdale), IL facility. The reported net loss was $41.4 million, versus $19.7 million income in the prior year; adjusted net income fell 47% to $10.3 million. The restructuring is a strategic repositioning amid weak European Polymers demand. Watch for execution milestones, site wind-down costs, and potential asset sales or further rationalization. This is an operational restructuring, not a sale or spin-off.
